Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 12 · NFL Week 10 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:44 AM ET

J.J. McCarthy has the highest SPAGS projection in the Commanders at Giants DraftKings Showdown: 18.0 points at $8,800 FLEX, 27.1 at captain for $13,200. In a game totaled at 41.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 5.9 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 83% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against McCarthy is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.7 points at an $8,800 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 18.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with McCarthy at captain. Jayden Daniels is the next captain in line, at 17.9%. The model has him running 4.9 times.

The Giants are a 2.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 22 for the Giants and 19.5 for the Commanders.

Behind McCarthy and Daniels, the next projections are Malik Nabers (14.7, $11,000), Cam Skattebo (12.3, $9,000) and Isaiah Likely (11.5, $8,200).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:44 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: J.J. McCarthy, NYG QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

J.J. McCarthy holds 18.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 18.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations McCarthy averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 36.8. He holds 83% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.7% as the captain and 63.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 17.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 17.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 36.4. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.9% as the captain and 52.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Malik Nabers, NYG WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Malik Nabers holds 12.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 14.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.1 targets on 20.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Nabers averaged 14.7 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 39.2. He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 42.8% in a FLEX spot.

Cam Skattebo, NYG RB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Skattebo averaged 12.1 points with a simulated floor of 2.2 and a ceiling of 31.0. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.5% as the captain and 32.5% in a FLEX spot.

Isaiah Likely, NYG TE ($8,200 FLEX / $12,300 CPT)

Isaiah Likely carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.5 DraftKings points for an $8,200 FLEX salary ($12,300 at captain). The model gives him 4.5 targets on 13.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Likely averaged 11.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.9 and a ceiling of 30.5. Across 10,000 simulations Diggs averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 24.3. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.2% as the captain and 23.0% in a FLEX spot.

Van Jefferson projects for 5.2 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 1.63 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 4.2 targets on 16.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 5.2 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.2. He holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.8% as the captain and 13.0% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Austin Ekeler, WAS RB ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Austin Ekeler projects for 6.8 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.47 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 6.5 carries and 1.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Ekeler averaged 6.8 points with a simulated floor of 1.9 and a ceiling of 13.7. He holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.1% as the captain and 6.6% in a FLEX spot.

Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

J.J. McCarthy holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 18.7%, ahead of Jayden Daniels (17.9%) and Malik Nabers (12.4%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Commanders vs Giants?

Build around Isaiah Likely at captain with J.J. McCarthy, Jayden Daniels and Rachaad White at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (261 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $11,300 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

J.J. McCarthy leads the SPAGS model at 18.0 DraftKings points for $8,800 at FLEX, or 27.1 points at captain for $13,200.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Commanders vs Giants Showdown?

Malik Nabers is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 32 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Commanders vs Giants DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Van Jefferson (5.2 points at $3,200), Austin Ekeler (6.8 points at $4,600) and Treylon Burks (5.1 points at $3,600).

What is the Commanders vs Giants spread and total?

The Giants are a 2.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 41.5, with implied team totals of 22 for the Giants and 19.5 for the Commanders.
